details: For finite concept classes. The order-compression lower bound is preserved under both subclasses and coordinate projections.
proof: Darnstadt, Kiss, Simon, and Zilles prove that order-compression number lower-bounds projected recursive teaching dimension, by projecting a maximal teaching plan (Theorem 4). Applying the same statement to every subclass, together with restriction of an order scheme to a subclass and its projection, gives the max-over-subclasses-and-projections minimum-teaching-set formulation.
name: Order Sample Compression / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
